acceptance_criteria: Every recorded observation names the command output or the source file that shows it.
Observations that could not be verified are marked as such instead of being recorded as facts.
What the workflow caught is recorded next to what it missed.
goal: Record every observation about the agent-loop workflow made while running PHON-1..PHON-8, with exact evidence, so the workflow can be improved afterwards.
non_goals: Changing voku/agent-loop itself from inside this repository.
